auditConclusions.realComputationalValue: Many scripts contain useful deterministic formulas and API examples, but most are CLI-oriented reference implementations rather than production services.
auditConclusions.promptWorkflowBoundary: SKILL.md files provide discovery, formulas, examples, and informal multi-skill sequencing; there is no executable cross-skill workflow runtime in the repository.
auditConclusions.productionReadiness: Not production-ready as a unified engine because output schemas, dependency locking, tests, point-in-time contracts, centralized caching, orchestration, lineage, and model governance are absent.
auditConclusions.recommendedUse: Use as an algorithm and domain-design reference. Reimplement selected kernels and provider patterns behind Athena contracts; do not install the repository wholesale.
